PACKAGE_FILES = [
    "myapp/__init__.py",
    "myapp/models.py",
    "myapp/service.py",
]

TEST_FILES = [
    "tests/conftest.py",
    "tests/factories.py",
    "tests/helpers.py",
    "tests/test_service.py",
]


def test_helpers_are_outside_production_package(package_paths: list[str], test_paths: list[str]) -> bool:
    return all(not path.startswith("myapp/_") for path in package_paths) and all(path.startswith("tests/") for path in test_paths)
